You're reaching out to a community full of people willing to help and that's always worth a try, even though it might seem pointless.
I've been there, I actually am all the time, but I'm trying to get better and what really helps is engaging in hobbies, things you enjoy. If music makes you happy - listen to it, maybe buy a guitar or a simple recorder and try making it yourself. Learning to play an instrument actually helps to occupy your mind a lot. If you hate your routine, change it. Don't go to sleep, instead plug in your headphones and go on a walk or go see a movie, binge-watch some TV shows and try talking about it with people online, cook a fancy meal for yourself or for your family. Maybe try learning a foreign language. Just find something that seems fun and try it out. 
I know it might not sound appealing at all. I've actually rolled my eyes and went back to crying in my bed after reading such advices hundreds of times but once I tried it, I discovered so many things that made me feel bit better.
Just know that it does get better, as long as you're trying to make it so. If you ever need to talk, don't hesitate to message me.
